newsitem.title: Australia: TENNIS-Sampras enters field for Australian Open.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-Sampras enters field for Australian Open.

text.p: Former champion and world number one Pete Sampras of the United States has entered next year's Australian Open, tournament director Paul McNamee said on Friday.
Sampras won the tournament in 1994 and was runner-up last year to fellow American Andre Agassi. This year Sampras was beaten in the third round by rising Australian star Mark Philippoussis.
"Pete Sampras has been a legend...at Melbourne Park," McNamee said in a statement.
"His record at this tournament is phenomenal. He has created some of the most memorable matches and results in history."
Organisers hope to attract most of the world's top 20 ranked men's and women's players for the January 13-26 event, the first grand slam tournament of the year.
